sources.title: How to Set Up NLLB-200 Locally: Tutorial | NLLB
sources.snippet: NLLB-200 can be set up locally in under 30 minutes with basic Python knowledge and a compatible GPU. The distilled 600M model is a good starting point — it fits on consumer GPUs and offers decent quality. For production deployment, use FastAPI or similar framework to serve as a REST API, and consider quantization and CTranslate2 for optimization.
